svg.title: What I build. LLM systems: RAG, tool-using agents, model routing and grounded extraction. Tools: Gemini, Ollama, Chromadb, Pgvector, Mcp. Seen in Owl, Tenax, Fulyn, Doc_Extract. Scientific ML: Epidemic models with learned parts, survival analysis and calibration checks. Tools: Pytorch, Cuda, Torchdiffeq, Scikit-Survival, Xgboost. Seen in Dengue, Oncology, Argus. Vision and sensors: Real-time detection and tracking, and a wearable IMU rig for gait data. Tools: Yolov8, Opencv, Bytetrack, C++, Platformio. Seen in People Counter, Gait. Data engineering: Postgres warehouses and pipelines for messy research data. Tools: Postgresql, Polars, Sqlalchemy, Alembic, Plotly. Seen in Allen Brain, Gait Analytics. Privacy-first tools: Analysis that runs locally, with differential privacy and PII detection. Tools: Opendp, Presidio, Ollama, Sqlite. Seen in Datasense, Seshat. Full-stack apps: APIs, web apps and a packaged desktop app, with tests and type checks. Tools: Fastapi, React, Typescript, Next.Js, Docker. Seen in Fulyn, Seshat, Tenax.
